cases.sentence: В восьмом месяце второго ___ правления Дария было слово Господне
cases.translation: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius's reign the word of the Lord came
cases.explain: The genitive case shows the possession: 'of the second year'.

cases.translation: The Lord was greatly angered at your ancestors
cases.explain: The verb 'прогневался' (was angered) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Не будьте, как ваши ___, которым взывали прежние пророки
cases.translation: Don't be like your ancestors to whom the former prophets called
cases.explain: Nominative plural as the object of comparison.

cases.sentence: На двадцать четвертый ___ одиннадцатого месяца пришло видение
cases.translation: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month the vision came
cases.explain: Temporal accusative expresses the time when something happens.

cases.sentence: Смотрю, передо мной некто на рыжем ___
cases.translation: I look, and behold, someone on a red horse
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (on) with a location meaning takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Ночью мне было видение. Смотрю, передо мной некто в горной ___
cases.translation: At night I had a vision. I look, and before me someone stood in a mountain valley
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) takes the prepositional case for location.

cases.sentence: Тогда ангел Господень сказал, Господи сил, до каких пор ты будешь отказывать в милости ___?
cases.translation: Then the angel of the Lord said, Lord of Armies, how long will you withhold mercy from Jerusalem?
cases.explain: The verb 'отказывать' (withhold/deny) takes the dative case for the recipient.

cases.sentence: Крепко возревновал я об ___ и Сионе
cases.translation: I am very jealous for Jerusalem and Zion
cases.explain: The preposition 'о' (about/for) takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: В восьмом месяце второго года правления Дария было слово Господня к пророку Захарии, сыну Берехии, внуку Иду.
reading.question: Who received God's word and when?
options: The prophet Zechariah, son of Berechiah, in the eighth month of Darius's second year
The prophet Isaiah in the first year of Darius's reign
Zerubbabel in the sixth month of the second year
Joshua the high priest in the seventh month
reading.correct: The prophet Zechariah, son of Berechiah, in the eighth month of Darius's second year
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'было слово Господня к пророку Захарии, сыну Берехии, внуку Иду' (God's word came to the prophet Zechariah, son of Berechiah, grandson of Iddo).

reading.ru: Смотрю, передо мной некто на рыжем коне. Он стоял среди миртов, что в горной долине.
reading.question: What does Zechariah see in his vision?
options: A man on a red horse standing among myrtle trees in a valley
A chariot with four horses of different colors
reading.correct: A man on a red horse standing among myrtle trees in a valley
reading.explain: The vision clearly shows 'некто на рыжем коне' (someone on a red horse) who 'стоял среди миртов' (stood among the myrtles).

reading.ru: Я спросил, Что это значит, мой господин? И ангел, который говорил со мной, сказал, Я покажу тебе, что это значит.
reading.question: How does the angel respond to Zechariah's question about the vision?
options: The angel says he will show what it means
The angel tells him to ask the priests
The angel says only God knows
reading.correct: The angel says he will show what it means
reading.explain: The text states 'ангел... сказал, Я покажу тебе, что это значит' (the angel said, I will show you what it means).

reading.ru: Это те, кого Господь послал пройти по земле дозором.
reading.question: What is the purpose of the riders with the horses?
options: They were sent by the Lord to patrol the earth
They were guards for the temple
They were warriors sent to fight
They were messengers to the kings
reading.correct: They were sent by the Lord to patrol the earth
reading.explain: The man among the myrtles explains 'Это те, кого Господь послал пройти по земле дозором' (These are those whom the Lord sent to patrol the earth).

reading.ru: Мы прошли по земле дозором, на всей земле покой и мир.
reading.question: What condition did the patrollers report finding on the earth?
options: Peace and rest all over the earth
reading.correct: Peace and rest all over the earth
reading.explain: They report to God's angel 'на всей земле покой и мир' (all over the earth there is peace and rest).

reading.ru: Поэтому так говорит Господь, я вернусь в Иерусалим со страданием, и мой дом там будет отстроен, возвещает Господь сил, и протянется над Иерусалимом землемерная нить.
reading.question: What does God promise regarding Jerusalem and His house?
options: He will return to Jerusalem with compassion, rebuild His house, and extend a measuring line over it
He will destroy Jerusalem and build a new city elsewhere
He will leave Jerusalem and never return
He will make Jerusalem even greater without rebuilding
reading.correct: He will return to Jerusalem with compassion, rebuild His house, and extend a measuring line over it
reading.explain: God says 'я вернусь в Иерусалим со страданием, и мой дом там будет отстроен... и протянется над Иерусалимом землемерная нить' (I will return to Jerusalem with compassion, My house will be rebuilt there, and a measuring line will be stretched over Jerusalem).
